root_causes.detail: The deterministic C++ PM contract required min_test_files=2 but authorized only tests/test_product.py and no expandable tests directory. CE correctly failed closed because no legal second test path existed.

The CE diagnosis added cross-task behavior binding for every test-depth deficit even when immutable PM authority contained only one task. That produced an impossible owner/consumer contract and caused repeated semantic-repair churn.

fixes.change: Keep canonical test files as exact targets while adding the narrow tests/ directory to C++ PM scope so CE may name additional test topology required by delivery depth.
Add cross-task behavior repair requirements only when immutable portfolio authority contains more than one task.

verification.red_tests: Both exact regressions failed before their respective fixes.
verification.exact_candidate_projection_replay: repair_feasible changed false to true; cross-task diagnosis removed for one-task authority
verification.live_retry_result: Fresh PM scope retained exact targets and added tests/ authority; CE legally produced tests/test_edge_cases.cpp and tests/test_invisible_rules.cpp.
